scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix server install --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix client install --legacy-peer-deps --no-audit --no-fund
scripts.dev: if [ ! -f client/dist/index.html ]; then npm --prefix client run build; fi && ./node_modules/.bin/tsx server/server.js
scripts.lint: for f in server/*.js server/config/*.js server/constants/*.js server/controllers/*.js server/middlewares/*.js server/routes/*.js server/services/*.js server/utils/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
